## Overview

This project designs and tests a defined-risk options strategy on a 5-instrument index-and-ETF cluster (SPX, RUT, NDX, TLT, GLD) and a 9-name adaptive wheel basket. The strategy harvests the volatility risk premium — the structural gap between options-implied and realized volatility — using iron condors and cash-secured puts.

The work covers:

- **Design.** 5-instrument iron condor cluster with 16-delta short legs, 5-fates per-side independent management, 5-layer halt framework with auto-resume + 60-day fallback, and a 5-layer adaptive wheel including regime-conditional delta selection and per-name realized-volatility forecaster.
- **Testing.** Multi-year out-of-sample backtest 2018–2024 with realistic friction modeling (VIX-scaled slippage, gap-aware stops, per-instrument tax overlays). Statistical significance reported with the **Deflated Sharpe Ratio** (Bailey & López de Prado 2014, with Eq. 9 implied-independent-trials correction) and **Probability of Backtest Overfitting** via combinatorially symmetric cross-validation.
- **Live monitoring.** [Hoeffding-bounded](monitoring.qmd) regime-change detection in the trader-application form — pre-committed `μ` from OOS, rolling 60-trade `X̄`, threshold semantics 50/25/10% on the probability bound.
- **3-head ML stack.** Calibrated XGBoost with auto-selected isotonic vs Platt scaling per Niculescu-Mizil & Caruana 2005 sample-size threshold, scale-pos-weight handling for class imbalance, and full pre-committed acceptance criteria with documented fallback rules for negative findings.

## Pre-commitment-driven methodology

Every parameter, threshold, and acceptance criterion is locked in version-controlled pre-commitment documents **before** the OOS backtest runs:

- [PRE_COMMITMENT_VRP.md](pre_commitments.qmd#vrp): 5-instrument iron condor cluster
- [PRE_COMMITMENT_WHEEL.md](pre_commitments.qmd#wheel): 9-name adaptive wheel
- [LITERATURE_FINDINGS.md](pre_commitments.qmd#literature): Per-paper methodology audit across the 8 reference papers
- [LITERATURE_GAP_ANALYSIS.md](pre_commitments.qmd#gaps): Identified ship-blocking and ship-improving gaps

Methodology amendments after pre-commitment are explicitly logged with date, reason, and disclosure (see §4.1 amendment, §5.1 amendment in the VRP doc).

## Reproducibility

Single-command reproduction from a fresh checkout:

```bash
git clone <repo>
cd FinalProject_FinTech533
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
PYTHONPATH=. python scripts/convert_optionmetrics_to_parquet.py   # one-time, ~80s
PYTHONPATH=. python scripts/run_full_pipeline.py                  # full ablation matrix
```

`SEED = 42` is consumed by every stochastic component (XGBoost, isotonic/Platt CV split, block-bootstrap). Two runs of the same commit produce identical equity curves to floating-point precision.
